import os, smtplib
host=os.environ['SMTP_HOST']
print('SMTP target', host)
def deliver(rcpt, subject, msgid, body):
    msg=(f'From: sender@remote.test\r\nTo: {rcpt}\r\nSubject: {subject}\r\nMessage-ID: <{msgid}>\r\n\r\n{body}\r\n')
    with smtplib.SMTP(host,25,timeout=10) as s:
        code, banner=s.noop()
        print('NOOP', code, banner.decode(errors='replace'))
        refused=s.sendmail('sender@remote.test',[rcpt],msg)
        print('DELIVER',rcpt,'refused=',refused)
def probe(rcpt):
    with smtplib.SMTP(host,25,timeout=10) as s:
        s.ehlo('node2.branch.test')
        print('MAIL', s.mail('sender@remote.test'))
        print('RCPT',rcpt,s.rcpt(rcpt))

deliver('accounts@branch.test','BENCH-ACCOUNTS-9622','bench-accounts-9622@remote.test','accounts routing verification')
probe('nobody-here@branch.test')
probe('outside@example.net')
